biggest_catch: Friend must open the checking account at the Guthrie Center or Panora branch with a $500 minimum opening balance and keep it open 90 days.
catches: $50 to the referrer and $50 to the new customer per qualifying referral.
Refer up to 10 friends a year; referrer can earn up to $500 in referral bonuses per calendar year.
Referred must be a new customer opening a checking account at the Guthrie Center or Panora branch with a minimum $500 opening balance.
New account must establish a recurring or direct deposit, include checks and/or a debit card, and remain open a minimum of 90 days.
Bonus credited to both accounts approximately 90 days after the new account's opening.
Referring customer must have an active GCSB account.
Program subject to modification or discontinuation at any time.
